desc: This is the domain where the board is most exposed and must be most disciplined. The claim - that the phenomenon interacts with observers, that experiencer accounts include a cognitive or precognitive component, and that this is a property of the phenomenon rather than of the witness - is not supportable from primary documents, and the board records it as a research direction rather than a finding. What is documented is that the government funded work in this space and kept funding it: the Star Gate anomalous cognition programme ran under federal contract from 1972 to 1995, and the AAWSAP reference documents commissioned by DIA in 2008-2010 include studies of field effects on human neurological tissue by Christopher Green, a former CIA analyst. The reason the domain will not close is that multiple independent principal investigators with clearances - Puthoff, Green, Vallée - moved between the psychic research programmes of the 1970s and the aerospace programmes of the 2000s, carrying the framing with them. That continuity is a documented fact about personnel even where the underlying claim is not documented at all. Scoring high on this domain means an entity advanced, funded or institutionalised this framing.
